# semiont start --service metrics --dry-run — the exact runtime commands a real

container rm semiont-prometheus
# require free ports: 9090
# write <config-stage>/prometheus.yml (launcher-owned; scrapes the collector readout)

# wait: http://localhost:9090/-/healthy (30s)
